snippet.title: My First Game Jam! - Ludum Dare 57 Compo Experience
snippet.description:
Ludum Dare Page:
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/interstellar-dragon-into-the-depths-of-space

I started making this video in early May, but got busy and a bit daunted about the scope of this video, but over the last couple of days I pushed on to make the remaining half of the video!
This is the first video I have done of this kind so let me know what you think!

Music in the vid is by me, note that the song playing during the first day section is a remix of Noodle Town (Platform Racing 2 main theme) by Jacob "Jiggmin" Grahn, all others are originals

The "Go Play Dragon Games!" banner is by me and features fan-art of characters from different games where you either (can) play as a dragon, or has the dragon(s) as (the) protagonist(s) of the story. Support cool dragon games, we need more in the world! Left-to-Right the dragons are:
Fynn (Cavern of Dreams) https://store.steampowered.com/app/2059660/Cavern_of_Dreams/
Draco (DracoFighter) https://store.steampowered.com/app/2027810/DracoFighter/
Magma (DragonMirroreD) https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870770/DragonMirroreD_with_Hyoga__Magma/
Hyoga (DragonMirroreD) https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870770/DragonMirroreD_with_Hyoga__Magma/
Foam (Six Legends) https://store.steampowered.com/app/2768130/Six_Legends/
Minty (Critter Cove [NPC]) https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631470/Critter_Cove/
Super Spirit Dragon (Super Animal Royale) https://store.steampowered.com/app/843380/Super_Animal_Royale/

Timestamps:
0:00 Intro (Music: Generic Song for Generic Dragons)
0:58 Choosing The Format (Music: Supermarket Cola Dash DX - Titlescreen Song)
1:34 Tools I Used (Music: Supermarket Cola Dash DX - Gameplay Song)
3:49 Theme Voting and Reveal (Music: Generic Song for Generic Dragons)
5:08 Day 1 - Gameplay (Music: Noodle Town Remix)
8:18 Day 2 - Graphics and Finishing Gameplay (Music: [Unnamed Song "Pro Song 5" by Camer the Dragon])
10:04 Day 3 - More Graphics, Audio, Finishing Touches, and a Couple of Issues! (Music: Interstellar Dragon - Non-Gameplay Song, Interstellar Dragon - Gameplay Song)
15:27 Post Jam - Playing, Rating, Commenting, and Feedback! (Music: [Unnamed Song "Pro Song 5" by Camer the Dragon])
17:13 Rating Results Revealed, The Future of the Game, and Final Thoughts! (Music: Interstellar Dragon - Gameplay Song)
19:46 Outro (Music: Generic Song for Generic Dragons)

Other Ludum Dare Games Shown:
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/pogo-dwarf
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/p8-sweeper
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/under-pressure
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/the-hole
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/shafted
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/undertetris
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/hexadig
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/take-your-meds
https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/depths-of-the-mind
(Bonus not shown from Tad) https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/57/dance-to-heck
